newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products fall sharply, except fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products fall sharply, except fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Thursday, especially gas oil, but fuel oil was firm.
Gasoline shed $5 in line with Brent crude futures.
Naphtha was softer with an aggressive bidder now covered and the reopening of the Skikda oil port.
Gas oil slumped by $13.00 on heavy profit-taking in the IPE futures market, but premiums for physical oil held steady.
Fuel oil remained tight. Barges settled at $122-124 after trading at $125, $126 fob ARA. A high sulphur cargo sold at $111.50 fob NWE, a low sulphur at $135.50 cif Italy.
